sources.entry: Robust IRC - IRC without netsplits. Distributed IRC server, based on RobustSession protocol. (Source Code) BSD-3-Clause Go

summary.one_liner: RobustIRC is a distributed IRC server, written in Go, meant to provide IRC without netsplits by using the RobustSession protocol.
summary.what_it_does: The README is nearly empty: it only says "Please see for documentation" and gives no link. Capabilities are therefore taken from the listing metadata, which describes RobustIRC as a distributed IRC server based on the RobustSession protocol, aimed at running IRC without netsplits. The README does not describe setup, configuration, or client usage, and no specific features are confirmed beyond that.
use_cases: running an IRC server without netsplits
self-hosted IRC for a team or community
notable: Distributed IRC server intended to avoid netsplits
Listed under Communication - IRC on awesome-selfhosted
caveats: README is nearly empty and only points to external documentation without a link
No install or run instructions are given in the README
Maturity and maintenance status are not stated in the provided material
